title: Count interventions mechanically: record every operator resume and hand commit in .ticfac/
body: ncv's acceptance says to count interventions and report the number, but no record counts them. This retro had to reconstruct 17 stops, 9 hand commits on the integration branch and 33 hand triages from checkpoint history and first-parent git log. Record each resume (who, after which stop) and flag every integration-branch commit that did not come from an attempt merge or the run itself, so the gate's one-intervention rule can be checked rather than argued.
